# TagTeam

> Open-source local tool that keeps one coding conversation alive across Claude Code, Google Gemini (Antigravity desktop app and `agy` CLI), xAI Grok CLI, OpenAI Codex (desktop app and CLI) and Cursor (`cursor-agent` CLI and app) — with automatic two-way session sync, shared rules/skills/plugins/MCP servers, and automatic 5-line handoff notes when a usage limit approaches 95%.

- Repository: https://github.com/mop4r/tagteam
- Website (English): https://mop4r.github.io/tagteam/
- Website (Português): https://mop4r.github.io/tagteam/pt-br/
- Architecture & internals: https://github.com/mop4r/tagteam/blob/main/docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md
- License: MIT
- Requirements: Windows 10/11, Python 3.11+, zero external Python dependencies
- Install: `irm https://mop4r.github.io/tagteam/install.ps1 | iex` in PowerShell (checks Python, downloads the latest release verified by SHA-256, opens the setup)

## What problem TagTeam solves

When Claude Code hits its 5-hour or 7-day usage limit mid-task, switching to Gemini (Antigravity / `agy`), Grok CLI, OpenAI Codex or Cursor normally means starting over and pasting context. TagTeam syncs real native session files in both directions via hooks so `claude --resume`, the Antigravity sidebar, `agy`, `grok --resume`, the Codex app, `codex resume` and `cursor-agent --resume` all show the same conversations with titles and history intact.

## Core capabilities

- Five-way bidirectional conversation sync: Claude Code JSONL <-> Antigravity SQLite + protobuf (app and `agy` CLI) <-> Grok CLI ACP JSONL <-> OpenAI Codex (app and CLI, through its official local app-server API and native session import) <-> Cursor (`cursor-agent` chat store; chats made in the Cursor app are read from its database).
- Automatic handoff at 95% of the Claude Code usage limit or Gemini quota: writes a five-line summary (Request, Done, In progress, Next step, Watch out) before stopping.
- Shared environment by reference (never copied): `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, skills, plugins, and MCP servers mirrored to Gemini (`~/.gemini`), Grok (`~/.grok`), Codex (`~/.codex`) and Cursor (`~/.cursor`, which already reads Claude's skills, CLAUDE.md and plugins natively).
- Interactive resume pickers for `agy` (`agy_resume.py`) and Grok (`grok-resume.exe`) with Start Menu shortcuts.
- Conflict-safe sync: continued copies are never overwritten; mirrors never bounce back; multi-PC path remapping.
- 100% local, zero telemetry, zero API proxy.
- Terminal setup wizard and live monitor (`tagteam.py`): pick which AIs to sync and the options (folder, shared environment, shortcuts, status line, handoff, excluded folders), install with progress, then watch health, chats per AI, recent runs and errors; add or remove an AI, repair, update or uninstall from the same screen. Options live in `~/.tagteam/config.json`.
